title: Tell the story to a first-time viewer
text: Long form gives the viewer the set-up (who, where, what happened) and a taste of the event before the speeches that need it. "Get in fast" (HKS-R1) means no warm-up. It does not mean no context.

source.heading: From the user's verdict on the 20261125 YT agent v1 (2026-11-25; HKS-C27 to C31 confirmed)

confirm: What set-up facts and event clip does the viewer get before the first speech that needs them?
